title: How Does a Thermos Keep Tea Hot?
short_title: How Does a Flask Keep Tea Hot for 12 Hours?
description: A thermos can keep tea hot for hours and cold drinks cold. Here is the simple science of the vacuum layer and the shiny walls that block heat.
comment: How long does your flask keep tea hot? Tell me below!

scenes.text: How can a plain steel bottle keep your tea hot for hours, even on a freezing day?
Heat escapes in three ways: by touching, by moving air, and by shining out as invisible rays. A thermos blocks all three.
It has two walls with almost no air between them. A vacuum. With no air, heat has nothing to touch and nothing to carry it.
The walls are shiny like a mirror, so the heat rays bounce back into the tea. And the lid traps the rising steam.
It works both ways. A cold drink stays cold, because heat from outside cannot sneak in.
